title: OQPSK Demodulator Baseband
text: Demodulation using OQPSK method, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type; {Output type}, {Phase offset (rad)} sets the phase of zeroth point of signal, {Symbol mapping} sets the signal constellation bit, {Pulse shape} sets the filtering pulse shape, {Rolloff factor} sets the raised cosine filter rolloff factor, {Filter span (in symbols)} sets the filter length, {Filter numerator} sets the fIR filter numerator, {Samples per symbol} sets the number of samples per symbol and {Rate options} sets the processing rate option Enforce single-rate. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input baseband waveform scalar | column vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: Output data integer column vector | bit column vector

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: Phase of zeroth point of signal constellation 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Symbol mapping
params.values: Signal constellation bit mapping Gray (default) | Binary | custom 4-element numeric vector of integers with values from 0 to 3

params.name: Pulse shape
params.values: Filtering pulse shape Half sine (default) | Normal raised cosine | Root raised cosine | Custom

params.name: Rolloff factor
params.values: Raised cosine filter rolloff factor 0.2 (default) | scalar

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Number of samples per symbol 4 (default) | positive even integer

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Processing rate option Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type double (default) | single | uint8
